# Sanoja

> Sanoja is a free, open-source Chrome/Edge/Brave browser extension for learning Finnish vocabulary. Select or double-click any word on any webpage and it translates between English and Finnish (direction auto-detected), reads the Finnish word aloud, and saves it to a local spaced-repetition word list for later review.

Sanoja is aimed at people learning Finnish (or English-speaking people living in Finland) who want vocabulary lookup to happen inline while reading real content on the web, rather than switching to a separate translator app or flashcard deck. It has no account system, no ads, no analytics, and no tracking — the word list is stored only in the browser's local extension storage on the user's own device.

Key facts:
- Free and open source (MIT licensed).
- Works in both directions: English word selected -> Finnish translation; Finnish word selected -> English translation. Direction is auto-detected, no language picker.
- Pronunciation: reads the Finnish word aloud using the browser's built-in text-to-speech.
- Spaced repetition: every looked-up word is saved automatically and scheduled for review using a Leitner-box system (correct answers space out to longer intervals; wrong answers reset to the next day).
- Desktop Chrome/Edge/Brave only (not iOS/Android Chrome).
- Translation is done via Google Translate's public web endpoint; no API key or cost to the user.

## Install

- [Chrome Web Store listing](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/sanoja-read-words-in-finn/eoiodkapeakjcapimphbcjmijddaadjk): install page.

## Finnish word guides

- [How to say "thank you" in Finnish](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/thank-you-in-finnish.html): kiitos
- [How to say "hello" in Finnish](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/hello-in-finnish.html): hei
- [How to say "goodbye" in Finnish](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/goodbye-in-finnish.html): näkemiin
- [Good morning, good evening and good night in Finnish](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/good-morning-in-finnish.html): hyvää huomenta
- [How to say "how are you?" in Finnish](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/how-are-you-in-finnish.html): mitä kuuluu
- [How to say "sorry" and "excuse me" in Finnish](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/sorry-in-finnish.html): anteeksi
- [How to say "you're welcome" and "please" in Finnish](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/youre-welcome-in-finnish.html): ole hyvä
- [How to say "do you speak English?" in Finnish](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/do-you-speak-english-in-finnish.html): puhutko englantia
- [How to say "I don't understand" in Finnish](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/i-dont-understand-in-finnish.html): en ymmärrä
- ["Shop" in Finnish: kauppa, and the three forms you need](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/shop-in-finnish.html): kauppa
- ["Rent" in Finnish: vuokra and housing words](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/rent-in-finnish.html): vuokra
- ["Doctor" in Finnish: lääkäri, and how to talk about health](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/doctor-in-finnish.html): lääkäri
- ["Pharmacy" in Finnish: apteekki](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/pharmacy-in-finnish.html): apteekki
- ["Work" in Finnish: työ, töissä and töihin](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/work-in-finnish.html): työ
- ["House" and "home" in Finnish: talo and koti](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/house-and-home-in-finnish.html): talo / koti
- ["Water" in Finnish: vesi, and why it changes shape](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/water-in-finnish.html): vesi
- ["Coffee" in Finnish: kahvi](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/coffee-in-finnish.html): kahvi
- [Numbers in Finnish: 1 to 10 and beyond](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/numbers-in-finnish.html): yksi, kaksi, kolme
- [Days of the week in Finnish](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/days-of-the-week-in-finnish.html): maanantai
- [Colors in Finnish](https://sanoja-app.github.io/words/colors-in-finnish.html): punainen
